title: Climatology
description: What the air holds decides how much of the Sun's heat the world keeps: carbon dioxide traps it, aerosols send it back. Unlocks the Climate Engine.

puzzle.goal: The air's carbon dioxide rises from a concentration c to C. Write the radiative forcing F it adds, in W/m², which grows with the logarithm of the ratio (coefficient 5.35).
puzzle.name: CO2 radiative forcing
puzzle.ask: Find F for doubling the pre-industrial carbon dioxide: c = @{c} ppm, C = @{C} ppm.
puzzle.method: The strongest absorption bands are already saturated; extra CO₂ only widens their wings, so each doubling adds the same.
